# Toggling enforcement on a budget

## When to use

- Disabling enforcement temporarily to allow a planned burst of spend, then re-enabling once it completes.
- Running a monitoring-only budget where spend should be tracked without blocking calls.
- Restoring enforcement after the reason for disabling it has passed.

## Notes

- Enforcement and `paused` are independent: a budget can be `enforced = false, paused = false` (tracking only), `enforced = true, paused = true` (paused but would enforce if resumed), or any other mix.
- `budget::update` can also flip `enforced` as part of a multi-field patch; this function is the single-purpose shorthand.
- Changes take effect immediately for subsequent `budget::check` calls.
